spans.s:
कण् कण्, cl. 1. P. कणति, चकाण, कणि-
ष्यति, अकणीत् or अकाणीत्, कणितुम्, to
become small; to sound, cry as in distress; to go or
approach: Caus. काणयति, -यितुम्, aor. अचीकणत्
and अचकाणत्, to sigh, sound; cl. 10. P. काणयति,
यितुम्, to wink; to close the eye with the lids or
lashes.
कणित, अम्, n. crying out with pain.
कणित कणित. See under कण्.

कण कण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कण्;
according to others related to कना, कनिष्ठ,
कनीयस्, कन्या, in all of which the notion of small-
ness prevails), a grain, a single seed; a grain or
particle of dust; flake (of snow); a drop of water;
a spark of fire, the spark or facet of a gem; an ear
of corn; an atom, a minute particle; small, minute;
(आ), f. a kind of fly, commonly कुमीरापोका; long
pepper; cummin seed; (ई), f. a drop, an atom; the
plant Premna Spinosa or Longifolia; a kind of
corn; see कणिका.
—कण-गुग्गुलु, उस्, m., N. of a
plant; [cf. गन्धराज, स्वर्णकर्ण, and others.]
—कण-जीर, अस्, m. a white kind of cummin seed.
—कण-जीरक, अम्, n. small cummin seed.
—कण-
भक्ष, अस्, m. ‘eating atoms or grains’ (?), i. e. liv-
ing on minute particles of food; a nickname of the
philosopher Kaṇāda.
—कण-भक्षक, अस्, m. a
kind of bird; [cf. भारिट, श्यामचतक, शैशिर.]
—कण-भक्षण, अम्, n. the eating of grains.
—कण-भुज्, क्, m. nickname of Kaṇāda; see
कण-भक्ष.
—कण-लाभ, अस्, m. a whirlpool.
—कण-शस्, ind. in small parts, in minute particles.
—कणान्न (˚ण-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose food
consists of grains.
—कणान्न-ता, f. the state of one
who is made to feed on grains (of rice).

काण काण, अस्, आ, अम्, one-eyed, monoculous
(अक्ष्णा काणः, blind of one eye); perforated, as a
cowrie broken or perforated by insects; (अस्), m. a
crow; [cf. एकाक्ष and काणूक.]
—काण-त्व, अम्,
n. one-eyedness.
—काण-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a
Yakṣa.

कणिक, अस्, m. a grain, an ear of corn; the meal
of parched wheat, the heart of wheat (commonly suji or
semoule); a small particle, as a crystal &c.; an enemy;
N. of a purificatory ceremony, viz, whirling round lamps
at sacrificial rites [cf. नीराजन]; N. of a minister of
king Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; (आ), f. a drop, an atom, a small
particle; small, minute; the plant Premna Spinosa
or Longifolia; a kind of corn or rice.
कणीक, अस्, आ, अम्, small, diminutive.
कणिश, अस्, अम्, m. n. an ear or spike of corn.

कणिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. कनिष्ठ], the small-
est, the most minute.

कणीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, very small; young, younger;
[cf. कनीयस्.]

कणप कणप, अस्, m. a kind of spear or
lance; (various readings have कणय and कनय.)

कणभ कणभ, अस्, m. a kind of fly with a
sting; [cf. कणा.]

कणाटीन कणाटीन or कणाटीर or कणाटीरक,
अस्, m. a wagtail.

कणाद कणाद, अस्, m., N. of a celebrated
sage, considered as the author of the Vaiśeṣika
philosophy, a branch of the Nyāya. He is also
called Kāśyapa, and considered as a Devarṣi; the
nicknames कण-भक्ष and कण-भुज् refer to
the etymology of this name कण-अद, ‘eating
atoms or grains;’ a goldsmith; [cf. कलाद.]

काणाद काणाद, अस्, ई, अम्, composed by or
relating to Kaṇāda.

कणूकय कणूकय, nom. P. (connected with
rt. कण्), Ved. to desire to utter words of blame or
censure.

कणे कणे, ind. a particle expressing the
satisfying of a desire.
—कणे-हत्य, ind. (rt. हन्),
[]
satiating one's self (e. g. कणे-हत्य पयः पिबति,
he drinks milk till he is satiated.)

कणेर कणेर, अस्, m., N. of a tree, Cascaria
Ovata [cf. कर्णिकार]; (आ), f. a she-elephant; a
courtezan.

काणेर, अस्, m. son of a one-eyed woman; one-
eyed.

कणेरु, उस्, m., N. of a tree; f. a she-elephant;
a courtezan.

कण्ट् कण्ट्, cl. 1. P. कण्टति, -टितुम्, to
go, to move.

कण्टक कण्टक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. कण्ट्?),
a thorn; anything pointed, the point of a pin or
needle, a prickle, sting; a fish-bone; a finger-nail [cf.
कर-कण्टक]; the erection of the hair of the body
in thrilling emotions, horripilation; any troublesome
seditious person who is, as it were, a thorn to the
state and an enemy of order and good government,
a paltry foe (क्षुद्र-शत्रु); a sharp stinging
pain, symptom of a disease; a vexing or injurious
speech; any annoyance or source of vexation; a term
in the Nyāya philosophy implying refutation of argu-
ment, detection of error, &c.; impediment, obstacle;
the first, fourth, seventh, and tenth lunar mansion;
(अस्), m., N. of a barber; N. of the horse of Śākya-
muni (a wrong form for कण्ठक); N. of an Agra-
hāra; (according to lexicographers also) a bamboo;
a workshop, a manufactory; fault, defect; N. of
Makara or the marine monster, the symbol of Kāma-
deva; (ई), f. a species of Solanum. (कण्टक takes
the form कण्ट at the beginning of some compounds
and in कण्टल, कण्टालु, कण्टिन्; cf. Gr. κεντέω
κεσ-τός, κέσ-τρον.)
—कण्टक-द्रुम, अस्, m. a
tree with thorns, a thorn bush; the Sālmali or silk-
cotton tree, Bombax Heptaphyllum.
—कण्टक-
प्रावृता, f. the plant Aloe Perfoliata.
—कण्टक-
फल, अस्, m. the Jaka or bread-fruit tree, Arto-
carpus Integrifolia; another plant, Ruellia Longifolia
(commonly called Go-kṣura); the castor-oil tree;
the Datura; the term is applicable to any plant the
fruit of which is invested with a hairy or thorny coat;
[cf. कण्टकि-फल.]
—कण्टक-भुज्, क्, m. a camel
(‘eating thorns’).
—कण्टक-मर्दन, अस्, ई, अम्,
treading down thorns; suppressing disturbances, an-
noyances, &c.; (अम्), n. the act of beating or
treading down thorns; suppressing disturbances &c.
—कण्टक-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having thorns, thorny.
—कण्टक-वृन्ताकी, f. the plant Solanum Jacquini,
a species of nightshade with thorny leaves.
—कण्-
टक-श्रेणी, f. the Solanum Jacquini; a porcupine.
—कण्टक-स्थली, f., N. of a region.
—कण्टका-
ख्य (˚क-आख्या), अस्, m. the plant Trapa Bispinosa.
—कण्टकागार (˚क-अग्˚), अस्, m. a kind of lizard;
a porcupine.
—कण्टकाशन (˚क-अश्˚), अस्, m. the
camel (eating thorns, thistles, &c.; cf. कण्टक-
भुज्).
—कण्टकाष्ठील (˚क-अष्˚), अस्, m. a kind
of fish, having many bones.
—कण्टकी-कारी, f.,
Ved. working in thorns.
—कण्टकी-द्रुम, अस्,
m. Acacia Catechu.
—कण्टकी-फल = कण्टकि-
फल.
—कण्ट-कुरण्ट, अस्, m. = झिण्टी, Barleria
Cristata.
—कण्टकोद्धरण (˚क-उद्˚), अम्, n.
weeding, extracting thorns &c.; removing annoy-
ances; extirpating thieves, rogues, &c., or all national
and public nuisances.
—कण्ट-तनु, उस्, f. a species
of Solanum.
—कण्ट-दला, f. the plant Pandanus
Odoratissimus.
—कण्ट-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the plant
Flacourtia Sapida.
—कण्टपत्त्र-फला, f., N. of
a plant, = ब्रह्मदण्डी.
—कण्ट-पाद = कण्ट-
पत्त्र.
—कण्ट-फल, अस्, m., N. of several plants,
= गोक्षुर; bread-fruit tree, Datura Fastuosa, =
लताकरञ्ज = तेजःखल (?); Ricinus Communis;
(आ), f. = देवदालीलता.
—कण्ट-वल्ली, f. = श्रीवल्ली-
वृक्ष.
—कण्ट-वृक्ष, अस्, m. = तेजःफल-
वृक्ष.
—कण्टा-फल, अस्, m. = कण्ट-फल.
—कण्टार्तगला (˚ट-आर्˚), f. the plant Barleria
Cærulea.
—कण्टाह्वय (˚ट-आह्˚), अम्, n. the tube-
rous root of the lotus.

कण्टकार, अस्, m., N. of a plant; (ई), f., N. of
several plants, Solanum Jacquini; Bombax Hepta-
phyllum, the silk-cotton tree; Flacourtia Sapida.

काण्टकार काण्टकार, अस्, ई, अम्, made of the
wood of Kaṇṭakāra.

कण्टकारिका, f. Solanum Jacquini; also the fruit
of this plant.
कण्टकाल, अस्, m. = कण्टक-फल, q. v.
कण्टकालुक, अस्, m. Hedysarum Alhagi.

कण्टकित, अस्, आ, अम्, thorny; covered with erect
hairs.

कण्टकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, thorny, prickly; vexatious,
annoying; (ई), m., N. of several thorny plants,
Acacia Catechu; Vanguiera Spinosa; Ruellia Longi-
folia; Zizyphus Jujuba, bamboo; a fish; (नी), f., N.
of several plants, Solanum Jacquini, red amaranth.
—कण्टकि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from a fish;
produced by the Mimosa tree.
—कण्टकि-फल, अस्,
m. the Indian bread-fruit tree or Jaka; see कण्टक-
फल.
—कण्टकि-लता, f. a gourd.

कण्टकिल, अस्, m. a thorny kind of bamboo,
Bambusa Spinosa.

कण्टालु, उस्, m., N. of different plants; Solanum
Jacquini; another species of Solanum; a bamboo.

कण्टिन्, ई, m., N. of several plants, Achyranthes
Aspera; Acacia Catechu; Ruellia Longifolia.

कण्ठ् कण्ठ्, cl. 1. P. A., 10. P. कण्ठति,
-ते, -ठितुम्, कण्ठयति, -यितुम्, to
mourn; to long for; [cf. उत्कण्ठ्; cf. also Gr.
πένθος, πόθος; Lat. patior.]

कण्ठ कण्ठ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. कण्), the throat, the neck (e. g. आकण्ठ-तृप्त,
filled up to the throat, quite satiated); the voice (e. g.
सन्न-कण्ठेन, with broken voice); sound, espe-
cially guttural sound; the neck (of a pitcher or other
vessel); the opening of the womb; metaphorically a
bud on a stalk; immediate proximity; the space of
an inch from the edge of the hole in which sacrificial
fire is deposited; the tree Vanguiera Spinosa; N. of
a Maharṣi; (ई), f. neck, throat; a rope or leather
round the neck of a horse; a necklace, a collar; [cf.
अधर-कण्ठ, उत्-कण्ठा; cf. also Lat. collum?].
—कण्ठ-कुब्ज, अस्, m. a kind of fever.
—कण्ठ-
कुब्ज-प्रतीकार, अस्, m. the cure of the preceding
disease.
—कण्ठ-कूणिका, f. the Vīṇā or Indian lute.
—कण्ठ-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, reaching or extending to
the throat.
—कण्ठ-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, being at or
in the throat; approaching or reaching the throat.
—कण्ठ-तट, अस्, अम्, m. n. the side of the neck.
—कण्ठ-तलासिका (˚ल-अस्˚?), f. the leather or
rope passing round the neck of a horse.
—कण्ठ-
दघ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, reaching to the neck.
—कण्ठ-
धान, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
—कण्ठ-नीडक,
अस्, m. Falco Cheela; a kite.
—कण्ठ-नीलक, अस्,
m. a torch, a whisp of lighted straw &c. (= उल्का,
commonly मसाल).
—कण्ठ-पण्डित, अस्, m., N.
of a poet.
—कण्ठ-पाशक, अस्, m. a halter; a
rope passing round an elephant's neck.
—कण्ठ-
बन्ध, अस्, m. a rope tied round an elephant's neck.
—कण्ठ-भूषा, f. a collar or short necklace.
—कण्ठ-मणि, इस्, m. a jewel worn on the throat,
a dear or beloved object.
—कण्ठ-रव, अस्, m.,
N. of an author; N. of a certain medical writer.
—कण्ठ-लग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened or suspended
round the throat; clinging to, embracing.
—कण्ठ-
लता, f. a collar; a horse's halter.
—कण्ठ-वर्तिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, being in the throat; [cf. कण्ठ-गत.]
—कण्ठ-शालूक, अम्, n. a hard tumour in the
throat.
—कण्ठ-शुण्डी, f. swelling of the tonsils.
—कण्ठ-शोष, अस्, m. drying the throat; fruitless
expostulation.
—कण्ठ-श्रुत्य्-उपनिषद्, त्, f., N.
of an Upaniṣad belonging to the Atharva-veda.
—कण्ठ-सज्जन, अम्, n. hanging on or round
the throat.
—कण्ठ-सूत्र, अम्, n. a kind of em-
brace.
—कण्ठ-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, sticking in the
throat; being in or upon the throat; guttural; being
in the mouth ready to be repeated by rote, learnt
and ready to be recited.
—कण्ठागत (˚ठ-आग्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, come to the throat (as the breath or soul
of a dying person).
—कण्ठाग्नि (˚ठ-अग्˚), इस्, m.
a bird (digesting in the throat or gizzard).
—कण्ठा-
[]
भरण (˚ठ-आभ्˚), अम्, n. a neck-ornament, a
necklace; a shorter N. of the work called Sarasvatī-
kaṇṭhābharaṇa.
—कण्ठाभरण-दर्पण, अस्,
m. a commentary of Rāmasiṃha-deva on the last.
—कण्ठाभरण-मार्जन, a commentary by
Hari-nātha on the same work.
—कण्ठावसक्त
(˚ठ-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, clinging to the neck, em-
bracing.
—कण्ठी-रव, अस्, m. a lion (roaring from
the throat); an elephant in rut; a pigeon; (ई), f. the
plant Gendarussa Vulgaris.
—कण्ठे-काल, अस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva (‘blue on the neck’).
—कण्ठे-
विद्ध, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—कण्ठेश्वर-
तीर्थ (˚ठ-ईश्˚), N. of a Tīrtha.
—कण्ठोक्त (˚ठ-
उक्˚), अम्, n. personal testimony.

कण्ठक, अस्, m., N. of a horse of Śākya-muni;
[cf. कण्टक.]

कण्ठतस्, ind. from the throat, with distinct
words, explicitly.
कण्ठिका, f. a necklace of one string or row.
कण्ठिन्, ई, इनी, इ, belonging to the throat.

कण्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being at or in the throat;
suitable to the throat; belonging to the throat, pro-
nounced from the throat, guttural; (according to a
Prātiśākhya the guttural letters are अ, ह्, and the
जिह्वामूलीय; according to Pāṇini अ, क्, ख्, ग्, घ्,
न्, and ह्; according to Vopadeva also ए.)
—कण्ठ्य-
वर्ण, अस्, m. a guttural letter.
—कण्ठ्य-स्वर,
अस्, m. a guttural vowel, i. e. अ and आ.

कण्ठाल कण्ठाल, अस्, m. a boat, a ship; a
hoe, a spade; war; an esculent root, Arum Campa-
nulatum; a camel [cf. कण्टकाशन and कण्डोल];
a churning-vessel; (आ), f. a churning-vessel.

कण्ठील, अस्, m. a camel; (अस्, आ), m. f. a churn-
ing-vessel.

कण्ड् कण्ड्, cl. 1. P. A. कण्डति, -ते, -डि-
तुम्, to be glad; cl. 10. P. कण्डयति,
यितुम्, to separate the chaff from the grain; to
protect; [cf. कड्: cf. also Lith. kándu, ‘to bite;’
Cambro-Brit. cat, ‘a fragment.’]

कण्डन, अम्, n. threshing, separating the chaff
from the grain in mortar; that which is separated
from the grain, chaff; (ई), f. a wooden bowl or
mortar in which the cleaning or threshing of grain
is performed.

कण्डरा कण्डरा, f. a sinew (of which six-
teen are considered to be in the human body); a
principal vessel of the body, a large artery, vein, &c.

कण्डरीक कण्डरीक, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Kauśika.

कण्डानक कण्डानक, अस्, m., N. of a servant
of Śiva.

कण्डिका कण्डिका, f. a short section, the
shortest subdivision in the arrangement of certain
Vedic compositions, as in the White Yajur-veda;
[cf. काण्ड and काण्डिका.]

काण्डिका, f. a kind of corn (see लङ्का); a kind
of gourd, Cucumis Utilissimus.

कण्डु कण्डु, उस्, m. f. or usually कण्डू, ऊस्,
f. (fr. rt. कण्ड्), scratching; itching, the itch; (उस्),
m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
—कण्डू-करी, f. the plant Mu-
cuna Pruritus.
—कण्डू-घ्न, अस्, m. the plant
Cathartocarpus (Cassia) Fistula; white mustard.
—कण्डूमका, f. (मका = मक्षिका or मशक?),
a kind of insect with a poisonous bite.
—कण्डू-
मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, scratching, itching.
—कण्ड्व्-आदि,
अयस्, m. pl. the nominal verbs, in the list of which
कण्डूयति is the first.
कण्डुक, अस्, m., N. of a barber.

कण्डुर, अस्, आ, अम्, scratching; (अस्), m. the
plant Momordica Charantia, a species of reed; (आ), f.
the plants Mucuna Pruritus and Aty-amlaparnī.

कण्डूरा, f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus; ‘what
causes itching,’ alluding to the irritating property of
this plant.
कण्डूति, इस्, f. scratching; itching, the itch.

कण्डूय, nom. P. A. कण्डूयति, -ते, -यितुम्,
to scratch, scrape, rub: Desid. कण्डूयियिषति.
कण्डूया, f. scratching, itching.
कण्डूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, scratching, rubbing.

कण्डूयन, अम्, n. scratching, scraping, rubbing,
itching; (ई), f. a brush for rubbing.

कण्डूयनक, अस्, ई, अम्, scratching, scraping;
(अस्), m. a tickler, one who tickles or scratches.
कण्डूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, scratching.
कण्डूयित, अम्, n. scratching.
कण्डूयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, scratching, a scratcher.

कण्डूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having or feeling the itch,
itchy; (अस्), m. an esculent root (Arum Campanu-
latum).

कण्डोल कण्डोल, अस्, m. a basket for holding
grain, made of bamboo or canes; a safe, any place
in which provisions are kept; a camel; [cf. कण्-
ठाल;] (ई), f. the lute of the Cāṇḍāla; [cf. कटोल,
गण्डोल.]
—कण्डोल-वीणा, f. the lute of the Cāṇ-
ḍāla, a vulgar lute.
काण्डोल काण्डोल, see above; [cf. कण्डोल.]
कण्डोलक, अस्, m. a basket, a safe, a store-room.
कण्डोष कण्डोष, अस्, m. a caterpillar.

कण्व कण्व, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
कण्), deaf; (अस्), m., Ved. a peculiar class of evil
spirits, against whom charms are used; a praiser;
N. of a renowned Ṛṣi, author of several hymns of
the Ṛg-veda; he is called a son of Ghora and is said
to belong to the family of Aṅgiras; (आस्), m. pl. the
family or descendants of Kaṇva; (besides the cele-
brated Ṛṣi there occur a Kaṇva Nārṣada, Kaṇva Śrā-
yasa, Kaṇva Kāśyapa; the founder of a Vedic school;
a prince, son of Pratiratha and father of Medhātithi;
a son of Apratiratha; a son of Ajamīḍha and father
of Medhātithi; the author of a law-book; a gram-
marian.) The name कण्व was perhaps originally
mythic, and afterwards transferred to a human
family, as was the case with the name Aṅgiras;
(अम्), n. sin, evil.
—कण्व-जम्भन, अस्, ई, अम्,
Ved. consuming or destroying the evil spirits called
Kaṇvas.
—कण्व-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very much
like Kaṇva, very wise.
—कण्व-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. prepared after the manner of the Kaṇvas (as
Soma); (Sāy.) united with praisers or with the
Kaṇvas (as Indra).
—कण्व-वत्, ind. like Kaṇva.
—कण्व-सखि, आ, m., Ved. a friend of the Kaṇvas,
friendly disposed towards them.
—कण्व-होतृ, ता,
m., Ved. one whose Hotṛ priest is a Kaṇva.

काण्व काण्व, अस्, ई, अम् (a patronymic fr.
कण्व), a descendant of Kaṇva; a follower of Kaṇva.
—काण्व-शाखिन्, ई, m. a follower of the Kāṇva
branch of the Veda.
—काण्वी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a
teacher.

कण्वाय, nom. A. कण्वा-यते, -यितुम्, to do
mischief; perhaps originally ‘to act like a Kaṇva or
evil spirit.’

काणेय, अस्, m. the son of a one-eyed woman;
one-eyed.
—काणेय-विध, अम्, n. a country inha-
bited by Kaṇeyas.

काणूक काणूक or कानूक, अस् (?), m. (said
to be fr. rt. कण्), a crow; the bird which makes a
hanging nest on the tāl tree; a cock; a species of
goose; [cf. काण.]

काणेलीमातृ काणेलीमातृ, a name of re-
proach, occurring generally in the voc. case; (according
to native commentators) one whose mother was an
unmarried woman, a bastard; (connected with the
word काणेर?).

काण्टकमर्दनिक काण्टकमर्दनिक, अस्, ई, अम्
(fr. कण्टक-मर्दन), resulting from the treading
down or crushing of thorns or enemies.

काण्ठेविद्धि काण्ठेविद्धि, इस्, ई or या, m. f. a
patronymic fr. कण्ठे-विद्ध.

काण्ड काण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt.
2. कम्), a section, part; a single joint of the stalk
or stem of a plant, i. e. the portion from one knot
to another (e. g. इषुस् त्रि-काण्डा, an arrow made of
a cane with three knots; but by Pāṇ.

, the
fem. should be त्रि-काण्डी); any part, portion or divi-
sion of a work or action; any distinct portion or
division of a sacrificial rite (as that belonging to the
gods or to the manes); the section or chapter of a
book, a separate department or subject (e. g. कर्म-
काण्ड, the department of the Veda treating of sacri-
ficial rites); a stalk or stem, a branch, a switch; the
part of the trunk of a tree whence the branches pro-
ceed; a cluster, a bundle; a multitude, heap, quantity
(at end of comp.); an arrow; a long bone, a bone
of the arms or legs (e. g. काण्ड-भग्न, fracture of
a bone); a cane, a reed (Saccharum Sara); a particular
measure; water; opportunity, occasion; a private
place, privacy, a secret place; praise, flattery; a
horse. (At the end of a compound काण्ड may
sometimes imply depreciation or deficiency, = vile,
low, bad, sinful, wicked, &c.)
—काण्ड-कटुक, अस्,
m. the plant Momordica Charantia, = कारवेल्ल.
—काण्ड-काण्डक, अस्, m. a species of grass.
—काण्ड-कार, अम्, n. the Areca or betel-nut tree,
commonly Guvāka; the betel-nut.
—काण्ड-कीलक,
अस्, m. the tree Symplocos Racemosa.
—काण्ड-
कुष्कु, उस्, m. (?), N. of a man.
—काण्ड-गुण्ड,
अस्, m. a species of grass.
—काण्ड-गोचर, अस्, m.
an iron arrow.
—काण्ड-तिक्त and काण्ड-तिक्तक,
अस्, m. a kind of gentian, Gentiana Cherayta.
—काण्ड-
धार, अस्, m., N. of a country; (अस्, अम्), coming
from or relating to this country.
—काण्ड-नील, अस्,
m. the plant Symplocos Racemosa.
—काण्ड-पट,
अस्, ई, m. f. or काण्ड-पटक, अस्, m. (?) an outer
tent, a screen surrounding a tent, a curtain.
—काण्ड-
पतित, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-king.
—काण्ड-पात,
अस्, m. an arrow's fall or flight.
—काण्ड-पुङ्खा, f.,
N. of a plant, = शर-पुङ्खा.
—काण्ड-पुष्प,
अम्, n. the flower Artemisia Indica, commonly Donā.
—काण्ड-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘arrow-backed,’ one
who carries arrows on his back, one of the military
profession, a soldier; (अस्), m. the husband of a
Vaiśyā female; an adopted son, any other than one's
own son; (अम्), n. the bow of Karṇa; the bow of
Kāma; [cf. काण्ड-स्पृष्ट.]
—काण्ड-भग्न, अम्,
n. a fracture or dislocation of the bones or limbs, com-
plete fracture of a limb.
—काण्ड-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of pieces of cane; (ई), f. = काण्ड-वीणा,
q. v.
—काण्ड-रुहा, f. a medicinal plant, = कटुकी.
—काण्डर्षि (˚ड-ऋषि), इस्, m. a Ṛṣi or divine
saint of a peculiar class, as Jaimini and others, who teach
a peculiar Kāṇḍa or section of the Vedas.
—काण्ड-
लाव, अस्, आ, अम्, cutting a cane or branch, intending
to do so.
—काण्ड-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, armed with an
arrow, an archer.
—काण्ड-वीणा, f. a musical instru-
ment composed of joints of reed, a reed-pipe (?)
played by the Cāṇḍālas; [cf. कण्डोल-वीणा.]
—काण्ड-सन्धि, इस्, m. a knot, a joint in the
stem of a tree or of a reed.
—काण्ड-स्पृष्ट, अस्, आ,
अम्, living by the military profession, living by arms,
a soldier; (अस्), m. a Brāhman who lives by arms; [cf.
काण्ड-पृष्ठ.]
—काण्ड-हीन, अम्, n. a fragrant
grass, Cyperus Pertenuis.
—काण्डानुक्रम (˚ड-
अन्˚), अस्, m. or काण्डानुक्रमणिका or काण्डा-
नुक्रमणी, f. an index of the Kāṇḍas of the
Taittirīya-Saṃhitā.
—काण्डेक्षु (˚ड-इक्˚), उस्, m.
the plant Asteracantha Longifolia and the plant
Saccharum Spontaneum.
—काण्डे-रुहा, f., N. of a
plant, = काण्ड-रुहा.

काण्डनी, f., N. of a plant, = सूक्ष्म-पर्णी and
राम-दूती.
काण्डाल or काण्डोल, अस्, m. a reed-basket.
काण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. reed-shaped, hollow.

काण्डीर, अस्, आ, अम्, armed with arrows, an
archer; (अस्), m. the plant Achyranthes Aspera and
the plant Momordica Charantia; (आ and ई), f. the
plant Rubia Munjista.
काण्डेरी, f. the plant Tiaridium Indicum.

काण्डणी काण्डणी, (?) f. a plant, commonly
Rāmadūtī; [cf. सूक्ष्म-पर्णी.]
काण्वक, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
काण्वायन, अस्, आ, अम्, a patronymic fr. काण्व.

कण्ट. See under कण्टक; (these words are
thought by some to be for original कर्न्त, कर्न्-
तक, fr. rt. 2. कृत्, to cut.)

काणभुज, अस्, ई, अम्, composed by Kaṇa-bhuj,
i. e. Kaṇāda.
